question: Indian classical vocalist Rashid Khan belonged to which of the following gharanas of music?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rampur - Sahaswan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rampur - Sahaswan** gharana is one of the prominent **gharanas of Hindustani classical music**.
 
• It is known for its emphasis on **pure classical music** and its rich repertoire of compositions.
 
• This gharana originated in the **Rampur and Sahaswan regions**, primarily under the patronage of the rulers of Rampur.
 
• The Rampur - Sahaswan gharana is closely associated with the legacy of **Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan**, who was instrumental in its development.
 
• Artists belonging to this gharana are renowned for their **melodious and intricate renditions** of ragas.
 
• Its vocal style is characterized by the use of **slow-tempo elaborations** and distinctive taans (rapid melodic passages).
 
• **Rashid Khan**, a celebrated Indian classical vocalist, belongs to this gharana and has been recognized for his mastery and innovation in Hindustani classical music.
 
• Rashid Khan is regarded as a **torchbearer** of the Rampur - Sahaswan gharana, blending traditional techniques with his own creative expressions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gwalior Gharana**__

 __
 
• **Gwalior gharana** is considered the oldest and most influential gharana of Hindustani classical music.
 
• It originated in the **Gwalior region** of Madhya Pradesh and gained prominence during the reign of Raja Man Singh Tomar.
 
• Gwalior gharana is known for its emphasis on **dhrupad and khayal singing styles**.
 
• Its compositions are characterized by **clarity and structure**, with a focus on detailed elaboration of ragas.
 
 
 
• **Atrauli - Jaipur Gharana**__
 __
 
• The **Atrauli - Jaipur gharana** is known for its intricate and highly sophisticated vocal techniques.
 
• It originated in the **Jaipur region** and was developed by **Alladiya Khan**.
 
• Artists from this gharana are recognized for their mastery of **rare and complex ragas**.
 
• It emphasizes the use of **layakari (rhythmic play)** and meend (gliding notes).
 
 
 
• **Lucknow Gharana**__
 
 
• The **Lucknow gharana** is primarily known for its contributions to **Thumri and Kathak dance**.
 
• It originated in the **Lucknow region** under the patronage of Nawabs of Awadh.
 
• Lucknow gharana focuses on **expressive and emotive singing styles**, often blending classical and semi-classical elements.
 
• It is characterized by the use of **delicate ornamentation** in compositions.
